company_name: YUEYANG KAIMEITE ELECTRONIC SPECIALTY RARE GASES CO.,LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in electronic specialty gases used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Yueyang Kaimite Electronic Specialty Rare Gases Co., Ltd. produces high-purity electronic specialty gases and gas mixtures essential for semiconductor lithography and other applications. Their products are certified by leading industry players and are exported to major semiconductor manufacturers globally.
capabilities: Excimer laser gas mixtures certified by Coherent
Ultrapure and rare gases including He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Yueyang City, Hunan Province, and serves both domestic and international semiconductor markets.
